item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 28/Dec/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be mainly fine over the coast of southern China for the rest of this week. Temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. A replenishment of the monsoon will bring cold weather to the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. With the monsoon moderating, temperatures will rise slightly over the region during the New Year holidays.

Date/Month: 28/12 (Wednesday)
Wind: Northeast force 4, force 5 later.
Weather: Mainly fine. Cool in the morning. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 14 - 19 C
R.H. range: 55 - 85 per Cent
